question: Should CodexBar officially support OMP session logs at `~/.omp/agent/sessions` as an additional maintained local-cost source?
rationale: The patch is mechanically narrow and proven, but it expands the application’s supported external log-source surface and therefore needs maintainer acceptance of that ongoing compatibility commitment.

options.title: Accept OMP support
options.body: Merge the focused scanner extension and treat the documented OMP path as a supported pi-compatible local-cost source.

options.title: Defer external-log support
options.body: Keep the existing pi-only scope and close or narrow the PR if maintainers do not want to maintain compatibility with OMP logs.

recommendation.title: Accept OMP support
recommendation.body: Merge the focused scanner extension and treat the documented OMP path as a supported pi-compatible local-cost source.

likelyOwner.reason: Repository-level ownership is the strongest available signal for deciding whether to expand supported session-log sources.
